description: This file defines the NsdHelper class, which manages Wi-Fi P2P (Bonjour/ZeroConf) Service Discovery and Registration using Android's NsdManager API. It handles initializing listeners, starting/stopping discovery, registering services, and resolving service info.

classes.name: NsdHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing network service discovery and registration via Android's NsdManager API, including setting up listeners, discovering services, resolving service info, and registering/unregistering services.

methods.name: NsdHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NsdHelper with application context and obtains the NsdManager instance.

methods.name: initializeNsd
methods.description: Initializes the resolve listener for service resolution.

methods.name: initializeDiscoveryListener
methods.description: Initializes the discovery listener to handle service discovery events.

methods.name: initializeResolveListener
methods.description: Initializes the resolve listener to handle service resolution results.

methods.name: initializeRegistrationListener
methods.description: Sets up the registration listener for service registration callbacks.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a network service on a given port, after tearing down previous registration if any.

methods.name: discoverServices
methods.description: Starts discovering services of a specific type on the network.

methods.name: getChosenServiceInfo
methods.description: Returns the currently resolved service information.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Unregisters the current service if registered, cleaning up resources.
